newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Premier expects real growth in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: Premier expects real growth in 1997/98.

text.p: South African food group Premier Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected to show real growth in its performance in the current financial year, despite continued competitive conditions.
It said in a statement accompanying year end results that it expected to enjoy the benefits of further interest relief and those from new ventures and restructuring initiatives.
"These are expected to combine to enable real growth in performance in the current year," Premier said.
Premier earlier reported a rise in headline earnings to 38.0 cents a share from 28.7 a year ago, just below an analyst forecasts' range of between 38.5 and 40.0 cents.
